RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so sex discrimination between you is virtually impossible to establish. While an all-male panel may fall short of civil service best practices or diversity guidelines, it does not indicate bias against you. 

Raising this issue would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation within the ministry. The selected candidate possessed relevant international project leadership experience that likely distinguished his application. Instead of questioning the panel's gender composition, send a polite follow-up regarding your requested written feedback so you can obtain substantive insights to support future applications.
